name: application-dropdown
title: Dropdowns
description: Contextual menu panels triggered by a button, for surfacing navigation, action, and settings options without leaving the current view.
useWhen: Providing secondary actions or contextual options that don't need to be permanently visible.
Building user account menus, per-row action menus in tables, or settings overflow menus.
Grouping navigation links that belong under a single top-level label.
avoidWhen: There is only one option — use a plain button instead.
The options are the primary way to navigate the site — use a persistent nav instead.
Users need to compare all options simultaneously before choosing — show them inline.
responsiveBehavior: Dropdown panels open relative to their trigger and reposition to avoid viewport overflow. On small screens, consider a bottom sheet or modal as an alternative for touch usability.
accessibility: Use role="menu" and role="menuitem" on the panel and its items so assistive technologies announce the menu pattern.
Trigger button must have aria-haspopup="true" and aria-expanded reflecting the open/closed state.
Arrow keys must navigate between menu items; Escape must close the menu and return focus to the trigger.

variants.title: Base
variants.description: A simple list of action items in a floating panel triggered by a button press.
accessibility: Panel uses role="menu"; items use role="menuitem"; Escape closes and returns focus to trigger.

variants.title: Base (Dark)
variants.description: Simple action-item dropdown panel adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark panel background and item text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast requirements.

variants.title: Divided
variants.description: Action list dropdown with horizontal dividers separating logically distinct groups of items.
accessibility: Dividers should use role="separator" to communicate group boundaries to assistive technologies.

variants.title: Divided (Dark)
variants.description: Divider-grouped action dropdown adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark separator colors must provide sufficient visual distinction between groups.

variants.title: Grouped
variants.description: Dropdown with labeled sections for organizing a larger set of actions into named categories.
accessibility: Group labels should use role="group" with aria-label to name each section for screen readers.

variants.title: Grouped (Dark)
variants.description: Labeled-section action dropdown adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark group label and item text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast requirements.
